verdict: Google went dark for most of last week; leads dropped sharply.
narrative: This period delivered 11 leads at a cost of $217.78 per lead, but the last 7 days deteriorated significantly — Google Ads ran on only 2 of 7 days, effectively going dark and accounting for the 50% week-over-week lead drop. Meta held its daily spend steady but produced no leads in that same 7-day window, which is being reviewed. The immediate priority is resolving who owns lead intake and response, as the current gap there is the gate blocking any scale-back-up on Google. Once the intake owner is confirmed and response workflows are live, Google spend will be restored and lead volume should recover.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days
total ad spend this period across Google and Meta

watch_item.issue: Google Ads was off for 5 of the last 7 days, and the lead intake seat that qualifies new contacts is currently vacant — together these have halted lead flow.
watch_item.fix: Confirming a new intake owner and reconnecting response automations to an active contact this week; Google spend will be restored once that handoff is in place.
